note: Phase 27 design log (docs/extreme90_phase27.md). Budget fixed before drafting: 8-10 concept proposals, <= 8 revisions per concept, <= 16 generator runs, <= 24 full evaluations. Drafts: d_round*.json; benched with tools/ta90_bench24.gd.

concepts.name: rim seal: the crate parked on the key's row seals the key
concepts.decision: INFEASIBLE: every pusher stays in the crate's line after a push, so the last pusher can leave only if its arrow changes (spinner / switch / Sequence) - without those a crate core is unsolvable (the reason every bank crate board has one)

concepts.name: the magnet as the gate's last link (its own departure opens the gate it pulls through)
concepts.decision: ENGINE-INVALID: a magnet must be a plain arrow (no link mark); the engine does apply gate opening before the pull, but the token is refused

concepts.name: the locked trigger: the switch is locked by a key standing face to face with it; a second free switch piece reverses the key out
concepts.decision: STOPPED: 205 of 207 qualifying boards (seed 62) carry an engine-invalid token; seed 64 on plain arrows: 0 qualifying

concepts.name: the remote ram: a spinner turned to face a portal cracks shells on the far side
concepts.decision: technically QUALIFIED (L2s62_477_4: 5 distinct, 18 moves, overlap 0.29) but REJECTED: conceptual relative of N34 / N40 (a turn sends the lane through the portal) and of the excluded K2 / H6 remote crack; look6 greedy 0.125 (above N60's 0.10, rated MEDIUM); seed 61 boards were shallow (dependency depth 3-5)

concepts.name: the shell's exit: an armored flip target faces its own rammer; once cracked neither can move until the reversal turns the shell away
one departure, two releases: the key is also the gate's last link
concepts.decision: STOPPED: the best board (L4s62_494_1) passed only with 2 filler spinners that act as walls - removed, its greedy shortcut is 0.49; every other shortlisted board has win density 0.53-0.56 and greedy up to 0.20 (the N54 profile)

concepts.name: the battering ram: a first-stage Sequence block rams every shell in its line; its advance turns its spinner neighbour
concepts.decision: STOPPED: on all three evaluated boards the Sequence block is NOT essential (without it: 14-15 decision steps, the same 5 distinct mistakes) - the generator's spinners do the work; L5s63_441 also look6 0.233

concepts.name: the trigger is the last link: the switch piece is also the gate's last link
concepts.decision: STOPPED: on all three evaluated boards the gate is NOT essential (without it: as many or more decision steps, the same distinct mistakes)

concepts.name: the locked flip target: flipped while locked, two switch pieces
concepts.decision: REJECTED before generation: the working form is 'leave between two firings' (N20 / N42)
